title: Research sprint goal: Freshness and census: the down window, the confirmable rule, soft 404s, unlocated anchors and mirror licences
goal: When does the lookup revalidation read a fact as current if the source's baseline is newer than the fact's confirmation? Which requests of the lookup revalidation read and record a host's down window? Does the lookup give a fetched page with no words a soft 404 verdict? Which facts does factdiff.py anchor --file anchor? How does kbid.py add read the licence of a Learn page through its public mirror? The _self docs answer these, but no tested question matches them yet, so each gets a tested row in kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv, a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 4 of 15): the five questions were run through rag.py pack --root _self at plan time: Q1 to Q4 weak (the _self docs answer them: kb/_self/tools.md:144, :160, :37; no tested question matches), Q5 none (content-rules.md:84 holds the Learn mirror sentence; the pack reads no NOASSERTION word). Each question's row quotes a phrase the sprint's items keep or rewords with the doc, so the items carry the eval file in their touches and run after this story. No outside facts: every question is a tool rule the _self docs answer, so no kb/public fact is written; its done is the landed rows.
